Information and purposes

The current review site has no active email collection or analytics tags. Your cookie choices are stored locally on your device for up to 180 days. Hosting providers may process routine security and access logs under their policies. The locally hosted photograph does not contact its source when this page loads.

If you email us, we use your message and address to answer your request. We propose deleting routine enquiries after 90 days unless a longer period is necessary for an ongoing request or applicable obligations. Please do not send sensitive personal information.

Optional features

Before enabling a checklist email form, we will identify the form/email processor and update this policy with retention and transfer details. The proposed form collects first name, email and consent. It will not collect phone numbers or SMS consent. Marketing messages need separate consent where required.

If enabled, Google Analytics and Google Ads measurement load only after the relevant optional consent. You can change your choice using Cookie settings. Withdrawing consent stops future optional tags on the next page load. Data already sent is subject to the provider’s policies. An optional YouTube video loads only after you click play and connects to YouTube’s privacy-enhanced domain.

External links and choices

Affiliate links open HighLevel, whose own privacy and tracking terms apply. We do not receive your card details. Contact us to request access, correction or deletion of information we hold, or to withdraw consent. We assess requests under the law applicable to you. For unresolved privacy concerns, you may contact your local supervisory authority.
